research_notes: Drafted 2026-10-20 by automated research; sources as listed. Second pass: the only official source found is the Assembly's own Proceedings of the plenary of 11 May 2023 (arp.tn document 90268, OCR text), in which the President of the Assembly announced six parliamentary blocs in order of filing under Article 11 of the Internal Rules: صوت الجمهورية, لينتصر الشعب, الأمانة والعمل, الأحرار, الوطنية المستقلة, الخط الوطني السيادي. Deputy heads (نائب رئيس) as printed: لطفي السعداوي (لينتصر الشعب), نور الهدى سبائطي (الأمانة والعمل), يوسف التومي (الأحرار), أيمن بن صالح (الوطنية المستقلة), عبد الرزاق عويدات (الخط الوطني السيادي); the deputy head of صوت الجمهورية is garbled in the OCR (possibly حمادي غيلاني). Verify: the year on the cover is garbled in the OCR ('0202'), but the term is 2023-2027 and it is the 10th sitting of the first ordinary session, so 2023; one OCR reading gives 'أمانة والعمل' instead of 'الأمانة والعمل'; member counts per bloc are garbled (printed as e.g. '02', '12', '11') and do not match the name lists, so no counts are recorded; the number of non-affiliated deputies was not announced at that sitting (a deputy objected). The bloc lists were to be published in the Official Gazette (JORT); that notice was not found. No newer official list was found: ARP newsletters no. 38 (1-15 April 2025, https://arp.tn/ar_SY/document/download/109177) and no. 50 (1-15 December 2025, https://www.arp.tn/document/download/115759) and the Finance and Budget Committee minutes of 23 October 2025 (https://arp.tn/ar_SY/document/download/115440) name no blocs. Bloc composition, heads and any later recomposition since May 2023 are therefore unconfirmed (press search results in Arabic report changes, not read as sources). OpenSanctions (tn_arp dataset, updated 2026-10-02) cites https://www.arp.tn/hemicycle/json as its source for members; that URL could not be opened (permission not granted) and the OpenSanctions member page checked shows no bloc field. No closure, merger or renaming found. state_ownership 'full' follows the public-body rule; the blocs are groupings of elected deputies inside the Assembly, so the verifier may prefer to merge this record into the Assembly of the Representatives of the People record. No budget or funding for blocs found.
